rationale: The codex subscription pool is exhausted for this window, so the highest-scoring option would have had to run openai/strong against billable API spend instead of the subscription. The request did not carry allow_metered, so that option was withheld and this is the best remaining non-metered one. devin/free is a visible downgrade in capability; that is the correct outcome, not a failure, because absence of subscription capacity never silently promotes to billable API (invariant 4). No fallbacks are offered: every remaining alternative is either the withheld metered option or weaker than this one.

metered_denied.message: openai/strong scored highest but its subscription path is exhausted, so serving it would have been billable per-token spend. allow_metered was not set on the request, so it was withheld and a non-metered option was returned instead. Authorizing this is a human decision, per attempt.
